method: Explicit isolated physical fixtures, not level solutions.
checks: Needed cog plus wrong bolt: neither consumed; remove bolt, cog is accepted.
Two required cogs accepted atomically, both counted.
Duplicate beyond remaining quota blocks the complete batch.
Required part blocks scrap too; remove it, scrap is consumed without scoring station parts.
Delayed falling wrong part prevents premature consumption of earlier correct cargo.
Held wrong cargo lifted fully above the rim no longer blocks settled correct cargo, even while still above the receiver.
Part resting out of reach on top of the gate returns to the pad without scoring; receiver contents excluded from recovery.
